mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_mgt( user_sys_id, recipe_title, recipe_info, recipe_steps, recipe_thumbnail_image, recipe_Instagram_link, recipe_video_link, rec_create_id, rec_create_date, rec_update_id, rec_update_date, logical_del_flag ) VALUES ( #{userSysId}, #{recipeTitle}, #{recipeInfo}, #{recipeSteps}, #{recipeThumbnailImage}, #{recipeInstagramLink}, #{recipeVideoLink}, #{userSysId}, now(), #{userSysId}, now(), '0' )
mapper.select: SELECT recipe_id::text AS id, user_sys_id AS userSysId, recipe_title AS recipeTitle, recipe_info AS recipeInfo, recipe_steps AS recipeSteps, recipe_thumbnail_image AS recipeThumbnailImage, recipe_instagram_link AS recipeInstagramLink, recipe_video_link AS recipeVideoLink, rec_create_date AS recCreateDatetime FROM recipe_mgt WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' ORDER BY rec_create_date DESC

SELECT recipe_id::text AS id, user_sys_id AS userSysId, recipe_title AS recipeTitle, recipe_info AS recipeInfo, recipe_steps AS recipeSteps, recipe_thumbnail_image AS recipeThumbnailImage, recipe_instagram_link AS recipeInstagramLink, recipe_video_link AS recipeVideoLink, rec_create_date AS recCreateDatetime FROM recipe_mgt WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND recipe_id = CAST(#{id} AS BIGINT)

SELECT recipe_id::text AS id, user_sys_id AS userSysId, recipe_title AS recipeTitle, recipe_info AS recipeInfo, recipe_steps AS recipeSteps, recipe_thumbnail_image AS recipeThumbnailImage, recipe_instagram_link AS recipeInstagramLink, recipe_video_link AS recipeVideoLink, rec_create_date AS recCreateDatetime FROM recipe_mgt WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND user_sys_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rec_create_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE recipe_mgt SET recipe_title = #{recipeTitle}, recipe_info = #{recipeInfo}, recipe_steps = #{recipeSteps}, recipe_thumbnail_image = #{recipeThumbnailImage}, recipe_instagram_link = #{recipeInstagramLink}, recipe_video_link = #{recipeVideoLink}, rec_update_id = #{userSysId}, rec_update_date = now() WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND recipe_id = CAST(#{id} AS BIGINT) AND user_sys_id = #{userSysId}
UPDATE recipe_mgt SET logical_del_flag = '1', rec_update_id = #{userId}, rec_update_date = now() WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND recipe_id = CAST(#{id} AS BIGINT) AND user_sys_id = #{userId}
